verses.text: People who do right die, and nobody takes it to heart. Merciful people are taken away, and nobody stops to think that they're being taken away from the evil.
They enter into peace. Each person who lived upright rests in their own bed.
“But come here, you children of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
Who are you making fun of? Who are you opening your mouth wide at and sticking your tongue out at? Aren't you children of rebellion, born of lies?
You work yourselves up among the oaks, under every green tree, and kill children down in the valleys under the cracks in the rocks.
The smooth stones in the valley are your share. Yes, that's what you've got. You've poured out drinks for them and brought them offerings. Am I supposed to be pleased with that?
You've set your bed on a high mountain, way up there. You went up to make sacrifices there too.

You've put your memorial behind the door and its posts. You exposed yourself to somebody besides me and climbed into bed. You made the bed bigger and struck a deal with them. You loved what you saw there.
You went to the king with oil and piled on the perfume. You sent your messengers far off and lowered yourself all the way to the grave.
You wore yourself out on those long roads, but you never said, ‘This is pointless.’ You found enough strength to keep going, so you didn't give up.
“Who scared you so much that you lied and forgot me, without even thinking of me? Haven't I stayed quiet for a long time, and you still don't fear me?
I'll expose what you call righteousness. As for what you've done, it won't help you.

When you cry for help, let the things you've collected save you. The wind will pick them up, and a breath will blow them all away. But anyone who runs to me for safety will possess the land and inherit my holy mountain.”
He'll say, “Build it up, build it up! Get the road ready! Clear away everything my people might trip over!”

This is what the One high above all says, the One who lives forever and whose name is Holy. “I live in the high and holy place, and also with people who are humble and sorry for the wrong they've done. I give life back to humble spirits and to hearts that are broken over their wrongs.
I won't keep arguing forever or stay angry for good. The spirits and lives I made would give out in front of me.
I was angry at his greedy wrongdoing and struck him. I turned away in my anger, but he kept straying down the road his own heart wanted.
I've seen the way he's lived, and I'll heal him. I'll lead him and bring comfort back to him and those who mourn with him.
I make these words grow on people's lips: ‘Peace, peace to the ones far away and the ones close by,’” says the LORD. “I'll heal them.”
But the wicked are like a restless sea that can't settle down, tossing up muck and mud.
“There's no peace for the wicked,” says my God.
